telas.como_provar: docker exec -i erp-postgres psql -U postgres -d erp_techsolutions -c "with t as (select 'a79aedf2-44c8-478f-a6ce-cf6248a16f2b'::uuid id) select 'conexoes sem desconexao no turno (0)' k, count(*)::text v from (select operator_profile_id, count(*) filter (where event_type='app_connect') c, count(*) filter (where event_type='app_disconnect') d from telemetry_events e, t where e.tenant_id=t.id and e.event_type in ('app_connect','app_disconnect') group by 1) x where c <> d union all select 'acessos nos ultimos 7 dias (>=112)', count(*)::text from telemetry_events e, t where e.tenant_id=t.id and e.event_type in ('app_connect','app_disconnect') and e.captured_at > now()-interval '168 hours' union all select 'perfis sem consentimento COM acesso (>=2)', count(distinct e.operator_profile_id)::text from telemetry_events e, t join operator_profiles op on op.tenant_id=e.tenant_id and op.id=e.operator_profile_id where e.tenant_id=t.id and e.event_type='app_connect' and op.tracking_consent=false union all select 'horas de conexao distintas (>=6)', count(distinct extract(hour from captured_at))::text from telemetry_events e, t where e.tenant_id=t.id and e.event_type='app_connect' union all select 'perfis sem nenhuma folga na semana (0)', count(*)::text from (select operator_profile_id, count(distinct date(captured_at)) n from telemetry_events e, t where e.tenant_id=t.id and e.event_type='app_connect' group by 1) y where n >= 7;"
